$comment: The declared shape of this app's runtime configuration. Names and purposes only —
never values, so this file is safe in Git and safe to read in a pull request.
Two checks keep it honest, because a manifest nobody verifies goes stale and then
scripts/ci/verify-env-manifest.mjs  every PR: this file matches what src/ reads
scripts/ci/verify-env-parity.mjs    before a production release: both Vercel
The point is that staging and production should differ only in credentials and
which resources they address, never in which variables exist. A variable present
in one project and missing from the other is drift, and it fails at runtime in
whichever environment is missing it — usually the one nobody is watching.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Supabase project REST endpoint. Differs per environment.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.purpose: Browser-safe Supabase key; RLS is what protects the data behind it.

variables.name: SUPABASE_AUTH_SECRET_KEY
variables.purpose: Supabase secret key (sb_secret_...) attached only to Auth calls with the visitor's IP (Sb-Forwarded-For), so Auth rate limits apply per visitor, not to the whole server. Enable IP address forwarding in the project's Auth rate-limit settings first.

variables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.purpose: Bypasses RLS. Server-side only: webhooks, crons, the health probe.

variables.name: R2_ENDPOINT
variables.purpose: Cloudflare R2 S3 endpoint (https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com) for session recordings.

variables.name: R2_BUCKET
variables.purpose: Private R2 bucket holding session recordings. Separate bucket per environment.

variables.name: R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.purpose: R2 API token key id, scoped to the recordings bucket. LiveKit Egress writes with it; the app signs and deletes with it.

variables.name: R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.purpose: Pairs with the R2 access key id.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_LIVEKIT_URL
variables.purpose: LiveKit project websocket URL, also the host the server SDK derives.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Mints room tokens, starts egress, verifies webhook signatures.

variables.name: LIVEKIT_API_SECRET
variables.purpose: Pairs with the LiveKit API key. Can mint a token for any room in its project.

variables.name: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Prerecorded transcription of each participant's audio.

variables.name: DEEPGRAM_MODEL
variables.purpose: Overrides the default nova-3 model, so a model rename needs no redeploy.

variables.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
variables.purpose: Invoicing. Test mode on staging, live mode on production.

variables.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.purpose: Verifies Stripe webhook signatures. Belongs to one endpoint, so it differs per environment.

variables.name: STRIPE_CONNECT_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.purpose: Signing secret of the Stripe webhook endpoint that listens to Connected accounts. Lesson invoices are direct charges on each tutor's own account, so their paid/failed events arrive through that endpoint, not the platform one. Same URL as the platform endpoint; the API accepts either secret.

variables.name: CRON_SECRET
variables.purpose: Bearer token Vercel Cron presents to the cron routes. Must differ per environment.

variables.name: APP_WEB_ORIGIN
variables.purpose: Exact trusted frontend origin for API CORS, CSRF and authentication redirects.

variables.name: APP_COMMIT_SHA
variables.purpose: Immutable commit identifier reported by the container health endpoint.

variables.name: APP_JOBS_DATABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Restricted private job-runtime role; direct or session PostgreSQL connection.

variables.name: APP_EVENTS_DATABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Webhook-intake login that can only persist signed provider events (private.accept_provider_event). Never the job or owner credentials.

variables.name: APP_JOBS_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Job schema owner connection used only by the explicit release migration command.

variables.name: VITE_API_ORIGIN
variables.purpose: Browser-safe API origin; omit only for a tested same-origin proxy.

variables.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Fallback AI Gateway credential, used only when OPENAI_API_KEY is not set; never browser exposed.

variables.name: APP_API_ORIGIN
variables.purpose: Trusted HTTPS API origin used by the Cloudflare same-origin relay. Set per environment as a Worker binding.

variables.name: PRERENDER_API_ORIGIN
variables.purpose: API origin the build reads approved tutors from when prerendering public pages. Unset skips prerendering.

variables.name: PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN
variables.purpose: Public site origin used for canonical URLs and the sitemap in prerendered pages.

variables.name: PRERENDER_REQUIRED
variables.purpose: Set to 1 in release builds so a missing prerender configuration fails instead of skipping.

variables.name: PRERENDER_DIST
variables.purpose: Test-only override of the directory prerendered pages are written to.

variables.name: APP_JOBS_RUNTIME_ROLE
variables.purpose: Name of the restricted worker login that the release re-grants private functions to after each migration.

variables.name: APP_EVENTS_ROLE
variables.purpose: Name of the webhook-intake login (execute on one function only) that the release re-grants after each migration.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Direct OpenAI credential for chat, summaries and embeddings. Preferred over the AI Gateway; never browser exposed.
